Activist Sonam Wangchuk Hospitalized Amid Hunger Strike Concerns

Activist Sonam Wangchuk has been hospitalized as his hunger strike enters a critical phase. His wife and a rights group have raised concerns about his treatment, stating it should not occur without consent. Meanwhile, a court declined to order his discharge, and a resurfaced clip of Wangchuk discussing an India-Pakistan film pitch has emerged.
